You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Question: Which category does a safety component with self-evolving behaviour based on machine learning fall under?

Facts:
[0] Safety components — areListedIn — REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5 (REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5) [condition: with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5]
[1] Machinery with embedded self-evolving ML safety-function systems — isListedAs — high-risk machinery under Annex I Part A point 6 (high-risk machinery under Annex I Part A point 6) [condition: the safety-function systems have not been placed independently on the market] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
[2] risk assessment and risk reduction — shall include — hazards arising during the lifecycle that are foreseeable at placing on the market as an intended evolution of self-evolving behaviour or logic (hazards arising during the lifecycle that are foreseeable at placing on the market as an intended evolution of self-evolving behaviour or logic) [condition: machinery designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy] [REG, Annex III]
[3] autonomous mobile machinery — shallBeEquippedWithDetectionDevices — devices detecting humans, domestic animals or other obstacles in its vicinity (devices detecting humans, domestic animals or other obstacles in its vicinity) [condition: where those obstacles could give rise to a risk to health and safety of persons or domestic animals, or to safe operation] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[4] Self-evolving control systems — shall remain correctable — at all times, to maintain inherent safety (at all times, to maintain inherent safety) [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[5] Automated machinery or related product components which have to be changed frequently — shallBeRemovableAndReplaceable — Components removed and replaced easily and safely (Components removed and replaced easily and safely) [REG, Annex III, 1.6.1]
[6] safety component — isDefinedAs — physical or digital component, including software, of a product within the scope of this Regulation (physical or digital component, including software, of a product within the scope of this Regulation) [condition: designed or intended to fulfil a safety function and independently placed on the market] [REG, Art. 3(3)]
[7] safety component — isDefinedAs — a component that serves a safety function, is independently placed on the market, and whose failure or malfunction endangers persons (a component that serves a safety function, is independently placed on the market, and whose failure or malfunction endangers persons) [condition: not necessary for machinery to function, or normal components may be substituted] [DIR, Art. 2]
[8] Category of machinery or related product — presents — serious inherent potential risk (serious inherent potential risk) [condition: assessed under paragraph 4, taking into account available information including paragraph 5 data] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[9] Autonomous mobile machinery — is defined as — mobile machinery which has an autonomous mode (mobile machinery which has an autonomous mode) [condition: all essential safety functions are ensured in its travel and working operations area without permanent interaction of an operator] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[10] human-machine interface — shallBeAdaptedToOperators — the foreseeable characteristics of the operators (the foreseeable characteristics of the operators) [condition: machinery with intended fully or partially self-evolving behaviour or logic designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[11] Self-evolving control systems — shall not cause — actions beyond the defined task and movement space (actions beyond the defined task and movement space) [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[12] safety devices fitted to jacks of hydraulic power circuits — isSafetyComponent — safety component (safety component) [condition: used to prevent falls] [REG, Annex II]
[13] Control system of autonomous mobile machinery — shall perform — the safety functions by itself (the safety functions by itself) [condition: even when actions are ordered by using a remote supervisory function] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[14] safety switches — isSafetyComponent — safety component (safety component) [condition: containing electronic components] [REG, Annex II]
[15] self-evolving machinery — shallRespondToPeople — people adequately and appropriately, verbally or non-verbally (people adequately and appropriately, verbally or non-verbally) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[16] devices to prevent the load-carrying unit from falling or unchecked upwards movement — isSafetyComponent — safety component (safety component) [REG, Annex II]
[17] safety component — hasSafetyFunction — designed or intended to fulfil a safety function (designed or intended to fulfil a safety function) [condition: independently placed on the market] [REG, Art. 3(3)]
[18] Category of machinery or related product — shall be included in — Annex I, Part A (Annex I, Part A) [condition: it presents a serious inherent potential risk and one or more of conditions (a) to (d) is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[19] Guards or protective devices against moving-part risks — mustBeSelectedBy — type of risk (type of risk) [condition: designed to protect against risks arising from moving parts] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8]
[20] Robot — initiates — Stop Category 0 (Stop Category 0) [condition: if the robot detects a fault or violation in the safety system (e.g. a cut wire in the Emergency Stop circuit or an exceeded safety limit)] [ur5e-manual, p. 109]
[21] Safety of robot application — dependsOn — tool/end effector, obstacles and other machines (tool/end effector, obstacles and other machines) [ur10e-manual, p. 183]
[22] Automated machinery components which have to be changed frequently — must be capable of — being removed and replaced easily and safely (being removed and replaced easily and safely) [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[23] autonomous mobile machinery or related products — shall have — a supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode (a supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[24] guards or protective devices for moving parts — shallBeSelectedOnBasisOf — type of risk (type of risk) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8]
[25] Safety-related parts of the controller that switch the active protective field — must provide — the same safety level as the safety function (the same safety level as the safety function) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 43]
[26] Unsupervised machinery — must be equipped with — appropriate acoustic or light warning signal (appropriate acoustic or light warning signal) [condition: where health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in its operation] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.1.2]
[27] devices for locking landing doors — isSafetyComponent — safety component (safety component) [REG, Annex II]
[28] Safety integrity level — is — SIL 2 (IEC 61508) and SIL 2 (IEC 62061) (SIL 2 (IEC 61508) and SIL 2 (IEC 62061)) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 129]
[29] Fault Detection — triggers reaction — Stop Category 0 (Stop Category 0) [ur10e-manual, p. 117]
[30] Degree of uncertainty — exists in — existing risk assessment methods related to new categories of machinery or technologies (existing risk assessment methods related to new categories of machinery or technologies) [condition: condition (d)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[31] Category of machinery or related product — lacks — harmonised standards or common specifications covering the relevant essential health and safety requirements (harmonised standards or common specifications covering the relevant essential health and safety requirements) [condition: condition (a)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[32] Any other category of machinery or related product — shall be included in — Annex I, Part B (Annex I, Part B) [condition: it presents a serious inherent potential risk but does not fulfil one or more of conditions (a) to (d)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[33] Each safety function and I/O — isConstructedAccordingTo — EN ISO13849-1 with Performance Level d (PLd) using a category 3 architecture (EN ISO13849-1 with Performance Level d (PLd) using a category 3 architecture) [ur5e-manual, p. 109]
[34] Category (ISO 13849) — is — Category 3 (Category 3) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 129]
[35] Robot application — requiresRiskAssessment — risk assessment (risk assessment) [ur5e-manual, p. 4]
[36] Safety devices fitted to jacks of hydraulic power circuits — isListedAs — safety component (safety component) [condition: where these are used as devices to prevent falls] [DIR, Annex V]
[37] The Commission — canIncludeSafetyComponentInList — a new safety component in the indicative list of safety components (a new safety component in the indicative list of safety components) [condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence] [REG, Art. 7(2)]
[38] This Regulation — applies to — safety components as a related product (safety components as a related product) [REG, Art. 2(1)]
[39] Safety Designer — isSoftwareFor — configuring safety solutions made by SICK AG (configuring safety solutions made by SICK AG) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 8]
[40] UR robots' safeguard stop — is — a Category 2 stop permitted to auto reset (a Category 2 stop permitted to auto reset) [ur5e-manual, p. 238]
[41] shock absorbers — isSafetyComponent — safety component (safety component) [condition: energy-accumulating, non-linear or with damping of the return movement] [REG, Annex II]
[42] The robot — can initiate — three types of stop categories defined according to IEC 60204-1 (three types of stop categories defined according to IEC 60204-1) [condition: depending on the circumstances] [ur10e-manual, p. 31]
[43] Non-fully automated machine with incorporated tool — mustBeDesignedToEliminateOrReduce — the risk of accidental injury (the risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[44] autonomous mobile machinery — shallOperateInEnclosedZone — enclosed zone with peripheral protection system (guards or protective devices) (enclosed zone with peripheral protection system (guards or protective devices)) [condition: where necessary according to the risk assessment, one or both of the listed conditions] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[45] non-fully automated machinery with incorporated tool — shallEliminateOrReduce — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [REG, Annex III, 2.3]
[46] Safety output — provides — safety-related information (safety-related information) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 147]
[47] Remote-controlled machinery — mustStopOperationAutomaticallyAndImmediatelyWhen — a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system (a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system) [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[48] Safety system — issues — Stop Category 0 (Stop Category 0) [condition: if a violation of the recovery limits occurs] [ur10e-manual, p. 119]
[49] Robot installation in hazardous application — safeguardingRequired — safeguarding (safeguarding) [condition: hazards cannot be reasonably eliminated or risks cannot be sufficiently reduced by built-in safety-related functions] [ur10e-manual, p. 185]
[50] machinery — isDefinedAs — an assembly with a drive system other than directly applied human or animal effort, consisting of linked parts at least one of which moves, joined for a specific application (an assembly with a drive system other than directly applied human or animal effort, consisting of linked parts at least one of which moves, joined for a specific application) [condition: fitted with or intended to be fitted with a drive system] [DIR, Art. 2]
[51] removable mechanical transmission device — isDefinedAs — a removable component transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and another machine at the first fixed bearing (a removable component transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and another machine at the first fixed bearing) [condition: when placed on the market with the guard, it is one product] [DIR, Art. 2]
[52] partly completed machinery — isDefinedAs — an assembly almost machinery that cannot in itself perform a specific application and is only intended to be incorporated into other machinery (an assembly almost machinery that cannot in itself perform a specific application and is only intended to be incorporated into other machinery) [DIR, Art. 2]
[53] interchangeable equipment — isDefinedAs — a device assembled by the operator himself with machinery or a tractor after putting into service to change its function or attribute a new function (a device assembled by the operator himself with machinery or a tractor after putting into service to change its function or attribute a new function) [condition: not a tool] [DIR, Art. 2]
[54] manufacturer — isDefinedAs — a person who designs and/or manufactures machinery and is responsible for its conformity with the Directive before it is placed on the market (a person who designs and/or manufactures machinery and is responsible for its conformity with the Directive before it is placed on the market) [condition: in the absence of a manufacturer, any person who places on the market or puts into service machinery is considered the manufacturer] [DIR, Art. 2]
[55] lifting accessory — isDefinedAs — a component or equipment not attached to lifting machinery that holds the load, placed between the machinery and the load or on the load, and independently placed on the market (a component or equipment not attached to lifting machinery that holds the load, placed between the machinery and the load or on the load, and independently placed on the market) [DIR, Art. 2]
[56] putting into service — isDefinedAs — the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by the Directive (the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by the Directive) [DIR, Art. 2]
[57] authorised representative — isDefinedAs — a person established in the Community who has a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform obligations on the manufacturer's behalf (a person established in the Community who has a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform obligations on the manufacturer's behalf) [DIR, Art. 2]
[58] placing on the market — isDefinedAs — making machinery or partly completed machinery available for the first time in the Community with a view to distribution or use (making machinery or partly completed machinery available for the first time in the Community with a view to distribution or use) [condition: whether for reward or free of charge] [DIR, Art. 2]
[59] Supervisory function — is defined as — remote non permanent surveillance of autonomous mobile machinery by a device allowing to receive information or alerts and to give limited orders to this machinery (remote non permanent surveillance of autonomous mobile machinery by a device allowing to receive information or alerts and to give limited orders to this machinery) [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[60] Supervisor — is defined as — a person responsible for the supervision of autonomous mobile machinery (a person responsible for the supervision of autonomous mobile machinery) [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[61] Driver — is defined as — an operator responsible for the movement of machinery or a related product (an operator responsible for the movement of machinery or a related product) [condition: may be transported by the machinery, on foot accompanying it, or guiding it by remote control] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[62] Organo di vigilanza che ha accertato la situazione di rischio — emette — disposizione sulle modalità di uso in sicurezza dell'attrezzatura di lavoro nei confronti del datore di lavoro utilizzatore (disposizione sulle modalità di uso in sicurezza dell'attrezzatura di lavoro nei confronti del datore di lavoro utilizzatore) [condition: non è stata accertata una contravvenzione] [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[63] self-evolving machinery — shallCommunicatePlannedActions — its planned actions, including what it is going to do and why, to operators in a comprehensible manner (its planned actions, including what it is going to do and why, to operators in a comprehensible manner) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[64] uso di una attrezzatura di lavoro — comprende — qualsiasi operazione lavorativa connessa ad una attrezzatura di lavoro, quale la messa in servizio o fuori servizio, l'impiego, il trasporto, la riparazione, la trasformazione, la manutenzione, la pulizia, il montaggio, lo smontaggio (qualsiasi operazione lavorativa connessa ad una attrezzatura di lavoro, quale la messa in servizio o fuori servizio, l'impiego, il trasporto, la riparazione, la trasformazione, la manutenzione, la pulizia, il montaggio, lo smontaggio) [DLGS69, art. 69, c. 1]
[65] Modifications to settings or rules by the machinery or operators — are not allowed — including during the learning phase (including during the learning phase) [condition: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[66] aggiudicatario — must respect — contents of this Scheda Tecnica (contents of this Scheda Tecnica) [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[67] Prestazioni dell'Appaltatore — sono riferite a — liste delle macchine/apparecchi aggiornate (liste delle macchine/apparecchi aggiornate) [condition: secondo il punto 2.4] [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[68] Scheda Tecnica — disciplina — verifica periodica (successiva alla prima) degli apparecchi di sollevamento di Igea S.p.A. (verifica periodica (successiva alla prima) degli apparecchi di sollevamento di Igea S.p.A.) [igea-equipment, p. 3]
[69] Pala terna CATERPILLAR (gommata) — builtIn — 1997 (1997) [igea-equipment, p. 7]
